beats.say: The new REPACK command reclaims disk space and reorganizes tables, and its concurrent mode doesn't block reads or writes.
Logical replication can now be turned on without a restart, sequence values replicate too, and a new WAIT command enables read-your-writes on standbys.
Heads up: max locks per transaction now defaults to 128 instead of 64, and a new 64-bit unsigned oid8 data type arrives, plus more jsonpath string methods.
